scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix "Projeto final/src" run typecheck && npm --prefix "Projeto final/backend" run typecheck
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:frontend && cd "Projeto final/src" && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
